ads.answer: No. Aura has no ad SDKs, no display ads, no native ads, and no house ads.

appAccess.reviewerInstructions: No login is required for the main app. Community actions use anonymous Firebase identity when enabled. Optional provider keys and Stability generation can be skipped during review unless the owner supplies test credentials.

targetAudience.rationale: Aura is a personalization utility with remote provider media, public community uploads, generated wallpaper prompts, YouTube tooling, and optional provider keys. It is not designed for children.

contentRatingNotes.answer: Personalization utility for wallpapers, live wallpapers, sounds, ringtones, widgets, and local editing tools.
Yes. Community sounds, wallpapers, creator profiles, reports, votes, follows, blocks, and collection shares exist. Report, block, owner delete, and admin moderation flows are documented.
Yes. Aura displays remote provider content and public community catalog content from configured sources.
Approximate location is requested only for optional weather wallpaper effects and is shared with Open-Meteo when enabled.
Contacts are selected through Android's contact picker and updated locally only for per-contact ringtone assignment.
Microphone recording is used only when the user explicitly records a community sound.
Generated wallpapers are text-to-image requests sent to Stability only after disclosure acceptance and user action. Generated results can be reported in app.
No ads, subscriptions, or in-app purchases. Some sources accept optional user-supplied provider keys.

ugc.answer: Aura requires users to accept versioned Community Guidelines before community feeds, uploads, votes, reports, blocks, follows, or profiles can proceed. Fresh installs do not create a Firebase community identity until an explicit community action needs one.

generatedContent.answer: Aura can generate wallpapers from text prompts through Stability after an in-app disclosure and can report generated outputs for Offensive, Unsafe, Deceptive, or Other reasons.

sensitivePermissions.name: android.permission.WRITE_SETTINGS
sensitivePermissions.declaration: Used after user consent to set selected sounds as ringtone, notification, or alarm tones.

sensitivePermissions.name: android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO
sensitivePermissions.declaration: Used only when a user records a community sound.

sensitivePermissions.name: android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SPECIAL_USE
sensitivePermissions.declaration: Used for opt-in wallpaper rotation triggers on screen-off or unlock.

sensitivePermissions.name: android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS
sensitivePermissions.declaration: Used for foreground service and worker notifications when required by Android.

sensitivePermissions.name: android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION
sensitivePermissions.declaration: Used for optional weather wallpaper effects.

sensitivePermissions.name: android.permission.WRITE_CONTACTS
sensitivePermissions.declaration: Used locally after contact picker selection to assign the selected ringtone URI to the chosen contact.

sensitivePermissions.name: android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE
sensitivePermissions.declaration: Legacy API 28-and-below storage compatibility for user-directed downloads and exports.

foregroundServices.functionalityDescription: Opt-in wallpaper rotation triggers listen for device unlock and screen-off broadcasts while the foreground service is enabled by Settings toggles.
foregroundServices.deferredImpact: Wallpaper rotation may be delayed until network and battery constraints allow AutoWallpaperWorker to run; manual wallpaper apply remains available.
foregroundServices.interruptedImpact: Trigger listening stops until Aura restarts the service from Settings or app cold start; existing wallpapers remain applied and no user data is lost.
